title: Elephant Poaching Fell 61%, But Herds Haven't Recovered
hook: Poaching fell 61%. Elephant populations still carry the damage.
closing: Lower poaching helps, but rebuilding elephant populations takes far longer than destroying them.
question: Can elephant herds fully recover?

segments.say: African elephants fell 77%, showing why a poaching slowdown does not erase decades of loss.
Only 415,000 elephants remained, leaving the population far below its earlier scale.
Elephant poaching fell 61% from its peak, proving protection can reverse the immediate pressure.
